question: Why Does Del Taco Sell Burgers and Fries?
quick_answer: Del Taco sells burgers, fries and shakes because it was built from the start as a mix of Mexican food and American fast food, not a taco-only chain. That combined menu is a deliberate selling point: a group can order tacos, burritos, cheeseburgers and crinkle-cut fries at the same counter, which sets Del Taco apart from Mexican fast-food rivals.
key_facts: Del Taco has mixed Mexican and American fast food since the 1960s
Signature crossover: tacos and burritos alongside burgers, fries and shakes
Crinkle-cut fries and the Double Del cheeseburger are longtime menu items
The mixed menu is a differentiator vs. taco-only competitors

body.heading: It was designed that way from the beginning
body.text: Del Taco was never meant to be a taco-only restaurant. Since the 1960s it has combined Mexican-style food (tacos, burritos, quesadillas) with American fast-food staples (burgers, fries, shakes). That blend is core to the brand, which has long marketed itself as a place offering 'Mexican food and more.'

body.heading: The burgers and fries are a selling point, not an afterthought
body.text: Having both sides of the menu is a real advantage. A group with mixed cravings can get tacos for one person and a cheeseburger and crinkle-cut fries for another, all in one stop. That flexibility helps Del Taco win family and group orders that a taco-only chain might lose.

body.heading: What crossover items is Del Taco known for?
body.text: Beyond tacos and burritos, Del Taco is known for its crinkle-cut fries (often loaded with cheese as Deluxe Chili Cheese Fries or Nacho Fries), the Double Del cheeseburger, and shakes. These American items sit right alongside the Mexican menu rather than being hidden in a corner of it.

faqs.q: Does Del Taco really sell cheeseburgers?
faqs.a: Yes. Del Taco sells cheeseburgers, including the Double Del, along with crinkle-cut fries and shakes, right next to its tacos and burritos.

faqs.q: What are Del Taco's fries like?
faqs.a: Del Taco serves crinkle-cut fries, which are also offered loaded as Deluxe Chili Cheese Fries and Nacho Fries. They are a longtime signature side.

faqs.q: Is Del Taco Mexican or American food?
faqs.a: Both. Del Taco is built as a mix of Mexican-style food and American fast food, which is exactly why it sells burgers and fries alongside tacos and burritos.
